dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Replay owns compatible evidence and uncertainty; PPO only consumes eight detached targets; the transaction owner sequences preview and commit.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The existing plan-stage-commit seam carries one typed candidate without a new wrapper or service hierarchy.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: PPO does not import Replay and Replay does not import runner, simulator, checkpoint or policy objects.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Candidate preview is immutable; matching exact-one receipt is the only Replay mutation boundary; v17/v3 migration is forbidden.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The semantic delta is confined to existing Replay, PPO, transaction, telemetry and checkpoint owners.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Production-boundary offline tests precede one live K8 transaction; simplified-test evidence and policy-quality claims are excluded.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: TEST-24A-D cover robust location, uncertainty, policy reset, Actor invariance, exact-one commit and v18 persistence.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Current M4 symlog utilities enter both the Replay candidate and current Actor advantages; compatible history enters Critic targets only.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Actor and Critic retain disjoint parameter groups, separate clipping and one optimizer step.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: checkpoint-v18/replay-v4 is strict; EVAL-v005 implementation is explicitly deferred until a v18 checkpoint exists.

residual_risks: The simulator, real HSL artifact and actual v18 serialization require one bounded official K8 transaction before any longer campaign.
